# GHL Prime
> GHL Prime is a dedicated GoHighLevel expert team providing CRM setup, automation workflows, AI agents, vibe coding, and 24/7 white-label support for marketing agencies, SaaS founders, and local businesses. US-based, GHL-certified, fully white-labeled. Clients can hire the full team on retainer or hire one individual GoHighLevel specialist for a specific project.

## Company
- [GHL Prime LLC](https://ghlprime.com): Legal name, founded 2024, HQ at 4801 Lang Ave NE, Suite 110, Albuquerque, NM 87109, USA. Email info@ghlprime.com, phone +1-505-207-5189
- [Octopi Digital](https://octopi-digital.com): Parent company

## What GHL Prime does
GHL Prime acts as the dedicated technical backend team for marketing agencies, SaaS founders, and local businesses that run on GoHighLevel. Services include:
- GoHighLevel CRM setup, sub-account configuration, and account migration from other CRMs
- Marketing automation workflow builds: speed-to-lead follow-up, appointment reminders, pipeline automation, review requests, database reactivation
- AI agent and voice receptionist deployment for lead qualification and 24/7 call handling
- White-label SaaS Mode configuration, Stripe rebilling, and SaaS launch for agencies
- Vibe coding: AI-assisted custom development for tools GoHighLevel cannot build natively
- Funnel design and landing page builds inside GoHighLevel
- 24/7 white-label client support and helpdesk coverage, invisible to the agency's own clients
- API integrations, webhooks, and custom dashboards
- Figma to code conversion and web/mobile app development
- Team training, SOP documentation, and ongoing GHL platform updates

## Hire an Individual
- [Hire an Individual](https://ghlprime.com/hire-an-individual): Hire one dedicated, GHL-certified GoHighLevel specialist matched to a single need, instead of a full agency retainer. A 3-step request form lets a client pick the services they need (GHL setup, workflow automation, funnel design, AI agent building, custom SaaS development, and more), select a monthly budget range, and set a timeline. Every specialist is GHL-certified and vetted, and deliverables still pass through GHL Prime's two-layer leadership review even on a single-specialist engagement. This page targets searches such as "hire a GoHighLevel specialist," "hire a GoHighLevel expert," "hire a GoHighLevel automation specialist," "hire a GoHighLevel developer," "hire a GoHighLevel freelancer," "GoHighLevel virtual assistant for hire," and "hire an AI agent builder."
- Specialists can also be requested by name directly from their profile card on the Hire an Individual page, each showing their role and core skills.

## Services (dedicated pages)
- [All Services](https://ghlprime.com/services): Full service catalog and overview
- [GHL Setup & Configuration](https://ghlprime.com/services/ghl-setup): Sub-accounts, pipelines, calendars, A2P/Twilio registration, and full GoHighLevel account setup
- [Workflow Automation](https://ghlprime.com/services/automation): Speed-to-lead, appointment reminders, pipeline automation, review requests, database reactivation
- [SaaS CRM Launch](https://ghlprime.com/services/saas-crm): Stripe rebilling, plan tiers, and white-label SaaS Mode launch for agencies reselling GoHighLevel
- [White-Label Support](https://ghlprime.com/services/white-label-support): 24/7 expert client support delivered under the agency's own brand
- [Vibe Coding & Custom Dev](https://ghlprime.com/services/vibe-coding): AI-assisted custom development and integrations beyond native GoHighLevel features
- [AI Agent Builder](https://ghlprime.com/services/ai-agent-builder): Lead-qualifying chatbots, voice receptionists, and AI call center agents
- [Custom SaaS Development](https://ghlprime.com/services/custom-saas-development): Client portals and dashboards built with Claude Code and Supabase
- [Figma to Code](https://ghlprime.com/services/figma-to-code): Pixel-perfect design-to-production-code builds
- [Web & Mobile App Development](https://ghlprime.com/services/app-development): iOS, Android, and web apps from MVP to production
- [SaaS Customer Support](https://ghlprime.com/services/saas-customer-support): White-labeled ticket handling and client onboarding, 24/7 coverage
